title: Agent Handshake config
description: The handshake.config.json file for an Agent Handshake gateway. Any string can use ${env:NAME} to read an environment variable when the gateway starts.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Link to this schema, for editor hints.

name.title: Gateway name
name.description: Name shown on the gateway's pages. Default: Agent Handshake.

publicUrl.title: Public URL
publicUrl.description: Address people and agents use to reach the gateway, like https://tools.example.com. The PUBLIC_URL env var wins. Default: the hosting platform's URL (Render, Railway, Fly), else http://localhost:<port>.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port to listen on. The PORT env var wins. Default: 7410.

host.title: Host
host.description: Network address to listen on. The HOST env var wins. Default: 0.0.0.0.

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Folder for the gateway's data, relative to this file. The DATA_DIR env var wins. Default: .handshake.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: How people pay for paid plans.

mode.title: Payment mode
mode.description: test: a fake checkout for trying things out. stripe: Stripe Checkout. external: send people to each plan's checkoutUrl. The PAYMENTS_MODE env var wins. Default: stripe when a Stripe key is set, else test.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.description: Stripe settings, used when the mode is stripe.

secretKey.title: Stripe secret key
secretKey.description: Stripe secret key. Use ${env:STRIPE_SECRET_KEY} instead of pasting it here. The STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env var wins.

webhookSecret.title: Stripe webhook secret
webhookSecret.description: Signing secret of your Stripe webhook (whsec_...). The STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var wins.

apiBase.title: Stripe API address
apiBase.description: Base URL of the Stripe API. Change it only for testing. The STRIPE_API_BASE env var wins. Default: https://api.stripe.com.

x402.title: x402
x402.description: Settings for pay-per-call plans paid with x402.

facilitatorUrl.title: Facilitator URL
facilitatorUrl.description: x402 facilitator that checks and settles payments. The X402_FACILITATOR_URL env var wins. Default: https://x402.org/facilitator.

allowInsecureClientMetadata.title: Allow insecure client metadata
allowInsecureClientMetadata.description: Accept http:// and private-network OAuth client metadata documents. For local testing only. Default: true when publicUrl is localhost, else false.

accessTokenTtlSeconds.title: Access token lifetime
accessTokenTtlSeconds.description: Seconds an access token stays valid. Default: 3600 (1 hour).

refreshTokenTtlSeconds.title: Refresh token lifetime
refreshTokenTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a refresh token stays valid. Default: 7776000 (90 days).

services.title: Services
services.description: The MCP servers to put behind the gateway. At least one. Each id must be different.

envRef.title: Environment variable
envRef.description: Read the value from an environment variable, like ${env:NAME}.

httpUrl.title: URL
httpUrl.description: An http:// or https:// URL, or one read from an environment variable.

service.title: Service
service.description: One MCP server behind the gateway, with its scopes and plans.

id.title: Service id
id.description: Short id used in links, like /add/<id>. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; up to 63 characters.

name.title: Registry name
name.description: Name in MCP Registry style, with exactly one slash, like com.example/my-tool. Default: local.handshake/<id>.

title.title: Title
title.description: Name people see. Default: name, else id.

description.title: Description
description.description: One line about what the server does.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version shown in the server card. Default: 1.0.0.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: URL of a square icon image.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Who makes the server. Shown on the install page.

name.title: Publisher name
name.description: Company or person. Default: the service title.

domain.title: Publisher domain
domain.description: Your domain, like example.com (no https://). Marked verified only when the gateway runs on this domain over https.

upstream.title: Upstream server
upstream.description: The MCP server the gateway forwards calls to.

url.title: Upstream URL
url.description: http(s) URL of your MCP server (Streamable HTTP).

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Headers sent to your server on every call, like an API key. Use ${env:NAME} for secrets.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout
timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for your server before giving up. Default: 120000.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Named groups of tools. A plan unlocks the scopes it lists. Tools in no scope are open on every plan.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: What people can sign up for. Plan ids must be different. Default: a 14-day free trial.

statusTool.title: Status tool
statusTool.description: Add a handshake_status tool that tells the agent the person's plan, usage and upgrade links. Default: true.

hideLockedTools.title: Hide locked tools
hideLockedTools.description: Leave tools the person's plan can't use out of the tool list. Default: true.

trialsPerIpPerDay.title: Trials per IP per day
trialsPerIpPerDay.description: Most free trials one network address can start per day. 0 turns the limit off. Default: 5.

description.title: Scope description
description.description: What this scope lets the agent do, in plain words. Shown on the consent screen. Default: the scope name.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Names of the tools in this scope.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: A plan people can be on: free, a free trial, paid, or pay per call.

id.title: Plan id
id.description: Short id, like trial or pro. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores.

title.title: Plan title
title.description: Name people see. Default: based on the price, like Free trial, Free or Pay per call.

durationDays.title: Length in days
durationDays.description: Days the plan lasts, like 14 for a two-week trial. Leave out for no end.

scopes.title: Plan scopes
scopes.description: Scopes this plan unlocks, from the service's scopes. "*" unlocks every tool. Default: ["*"].

default.title: Default plan
default.description: New installs start on this plan. Default: the plan with id trial, else the first free plan, else the first plan.

checkoutUrl.title: Checkout URL
checkoutUrl.description: Your own checkout page for this plan. Used instead of Stripe or test checkout. Needed on every paid plan when payments.mode is external.

stripePriceId.title: Stripe price id
stripePriceId.description: Stripe Price to charge, like price_123. Without it the gateway builds the price from price.

price.title: Price
price.description: 0 for free. A plain number is USD per month. Or an object with amount, currency and interval.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Price in whole currency units, like 9 or 9.99. 0 makes the plan free.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code, like USD or EUR. Default: USD.

interval.title: Billing interval
interval.description: How often to charge. Leave out for a one-time payment.

calls.title: Call limit
calls.description: Most tool calls allowed per period.

period.title: Period
period.description: When the counts reset: total (never), day, or month (every 30 days). Default: total.

spendUsd.title: Spend limit
spendUsd.description: Most USD the plan may spend per period on pay-per-call tools. Free trials default to 0.

x402Plan.title: Pay per call (x402)
x402Plan.description: Charge for each tool call with x402. The agent pays in USDC; no account or card needed.

pricePerCall.title: Price per call
pricePerCall.description: USD charged for each call. Best as a string, like "0.01".

payTo.title: Pay to
payTo.description: Wallet address that receives the payments.

network.title: Network
network.description: Chain to pay on, as a CAIP-2 id. eip155:8453 is Base; eip155:84532 is Base Sepolia, a testnet. Default: eip155:84532 (testnet).

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Name of the token shown to people. Default: USDC.

assetAddress.title: Token address
assetAddress.description: Token contract address. Needed on networks other than Base and Base Sepolia.

assetDecimals.title: Token decimals
assetDecimals.description: Decimal places of the token. Default: 6, as for USDC.

assetName.title: Token signing name
assetName.description: Token name used for signing (EIP-712 domain name). Default: the known USDC name, else asset.

assetVersion.title: Token signing version
assetVersion.description: Token version used for signing (EIP-712 domain version). Default: the known value, else 2.
